shared_elements: carved stone surface with figural relief
arm or hand-like forms rendered in low relief
justification: Both are carved stone monuments using schematic relief with a circular motif and hand/arm-like forms, but A depicts a single monumental anthropomorphic figure with its own body (arms, belt, torso) while B depicts a flat stele bearing multiple animal figures (bird, fox-like creature) and architectural arches arranged in registers. The overall composition, subject matter (single humanoid vs. multi-figure animal frieze), and arrangement of elements differ fundamentally, limiting the correspondence to generic carving conventions rather than shared iconography.
